column1: # Standardized Shader File Format & Native Metal Conversion Pipeline Database

column5: 32B DXBC Header: magic[4]='DXBC', md5_digest[16], ver=1.0(u16x2), total_size(u32), part_count(u32), part_offsets[part_count]
column6: DXIL (24B ProgramHeader + 'BC\xc0\xde' LLVM 3.7 bitcode), PSV0 (Pipeline State Validation + resources + wave size), RTS0 (Root Signature), RDAT (DXR Library Runtime Data), SFI0 (Feature Flags), HASH

column5: 24B DxilProgramHeader (ProgramVersion u32, SizeInUint32 u32, 'DXIL'[4], DxilVersion u32, BitcodeOffset u32, BitcodeSize u32) or raw LLVM 3.7 bitcode stream
column6: MODULE_BLOCK (8), PARAMATTR_BLOCK (9), TYPE_BLOCK (17), FUNCTION_BLOCK (12), VALUE_SYMTAB (14), METADATA_BLOCK (15: dx.entryPoints, dx.resources, dx.shaderModel)
column7: Wrap in signed DXBC(DXIL) container -> libmetalirconverter.dylib -> Metal IR (.metallib) -> ~/Translator/ShaderCache/*.aw2s

column5: 32B DXBC Header + SHEX/SHDR token stream (VersionToken u32 = kind<<16 | major<<4 | minor, LengthInDwords u32, D3D10_SB_OPCODE_* tokens)
column6: SHEX/SHDR (SM4/5 Opcode Stream), ISGN (Input Signature), OSGN (Output Signature), PCSG (Patch Constant Signature), RDEF (Resource Definitions), STAT
column7: DXBC(SHEX/SHDR) -> libdxilconv.dylib (IDxbcConverter) -> Signed DXBC(DXIL SM 6.0) -> libmetalirconverter.dylib -> Metal IR (.metallib)

column5: 32B DXBC Header + RTS0 part (Version u32=1|2, NumParameters u32, RootParametersOffset u32, NumStaticSamplers u32, StaticSamplersOffset u32, Flags u32)
column6: RTS0 (DescriptorTable / RootConstants / RootCBV / RootSRV / RootUAV + StaticSamplers)

column5: 20B (5-word) Header: magic=0x07230203, version=0x00MMmm00 (1.0..1.6), generator_magic(tool_id<<16|ver), bound(max_id+1), schema=0
column6: Word-stream instructions (wc=w>>16, op=w&0xFFFF): OpCapability(17), OpExtInstImport(11), OpMemoryModel(14), OpEntryPoint(15), OpExecutionMode(16), OpDecorate(71 DescriptorSet/Binding), OpFunction(54)..OpFunctionEnd(56)
column7: SPIR-V -> naga (spv-in -> Validator -> msl-out Metal 3.1) -> xcrun -sdk macosx metal (.air) -> xcrun metallib (.metallib) -> ~/Translator/ShaderCache/*.aw2s

column5: Northlight RFX v6/v7 Header: version(u32), 6 stage presence flags (VS,PS,GS,HS,DS,CS), constant buffers, SRVs, UAVs, samplers, permutation table
column6: Per-permutation compressed/raw DXBC(DXIL) shader containers + engine reflection tables
column7: aw2_data::rfx::RfxFile::parse -> extract DXBC(DXIL) permutations + covering RootSignature -> ShaderPipeline -> ~/Translator/ShaderCache/*.aw2s

column6: struct declarations, @group(G) @binding(B) var<uniform|storage>, @vertex/@fragment/@compute fn entry points
column7: WGSL -> naga (wgsl-in -> Validator -> msl-out Metal 3.1) -> xcrun metal (.air) -> xcrun metallib (.metallib)

column6: Constant buffers (b#), textures/buffers (t#), UAVs (u#), samplers (s#), shader stage entry functions
#version directive, layout(set, binding) uniforms/buffers, void main()

column5: UTF-8 Metal C++14/C++17 shading language source
column7: xcrun -sdk macosx metal -std=metal3.1 (or -std=metal4.1 / -fmetal-rtz-fp-conversion with PORT_METAL41=1) -O2 -c -> .air -> xcrun metallib -> .metallib

column4: DE C0 17 0B (LLVM bitcode wrapper) or 42 43 C0 DE ('BC\xc0\xde')
column5: 20B LLVM Bitcode Wrapper (Magic=0x0B17C0DE, Version=0, Offset, Size, CPUType) + AIR bitcode stream
column6: air.vertex / air.fragment / air.kernel metadata + Apple GPU LLVM IR

column5: MTLB container header: magic[4]='MTLB', platform/version tags, file size, function list offset, bitcode payload offset
column6: NAME (entry function names), MDSZ, TYPE, HASH, Embedded AIR bitcode / GPU machine code
column7: Ready for direct execution via MTLDevice::newLibraryWithData:

column5: 8B Magic 'AW2SHC02' + 16B Key(u128 LE) + Wire ShaderReflection + MTLB .metallib bytes + 16B XXH128 checksum
column6: ShaderStage, Metal function_name, ResourceLocations[], FunctionConstants[], StageInfo, Reflection JSON, MTLB .metallib
column7: Zero-copy pure-Rust decode in ShaderCache -> MTLDevice::newLibraryWithData:

column2: Windows PE Executable / DLL with Embedded Shaders
column5: DOS Header + PE32+ OptionalHeader + Section Table (.text, .rdata, .data) containing embedded shader arrays
column6: Embedded DXBC(DXIL SM6), DXBC(SHEX/SHDR SM4/5), and/or Vulkan SPIR-V (0x07230203) binary modules
column7: extract_pe_shaders + extract_pe_spirv_shaders -> DX12/DX11 + Vulkan native pipelines -> ~/Translator/ShaderCache/*.aw2s
